test_title: PYST 6 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 14 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct one-word substitute for:
 **A person who is unable to pay their debts.**
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. Bankrupt .
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 __ 
• The word **Bankrupt** refers to a person who is legally declared unable to pay their debts. 
• While **Debtor** is someone who owes money, it does not necessarily imply legal insolvency. 
• **Pauper** denotes a very poor person, but it does not directly refer to the specific status of being unable to pay debts. 
• **Lender** refers to an individual or a financial institution that makes funds available to another. 
Correct sentence: *The correct one-word substitute for a person who is unable to pay their debts is **Bankrupt**.*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 
• **Bankrupt:** 
• Legally declared unable to pay debts. 
• Often involves a legal process to resolve financial obligations. 
• **Debtor:** 
• A person who owes money. 
• Does not necessarily imply financial insolvency. 
• **Pauper:** 
• A very poor person. 
• Does not directly mean inability to pay debts. 
• **Lender:** 
• A person or organization that lends money. 
• Expects the borrowed amount to be repaid, usually with interest. </ul
